about_the_game:
Claw machine madness meets multiplayer mayhem!
In Grab Your Friends, you're the claw – and your friends are the prizes. While you try to grab them from above in VR, they’re scrambling around inside the machine, hiding, confusing you, and using sneaky tricks to stay out of reach. Can you catch them all before time runs out?

VR vs Mobile: Cross-Platform Chaos

  • 1 player in VR controls the claw and hunts down the others.

  • Up to 4 friends on mobile run around inside the claw machine – using real selfie avatars and special hats with unique powers!

Hide, Trick, Distract – The Hats

Each hat gives you a different ability:
🤲🏼 Illusion Hat – Create a second version of yourself and switch places to confuse the claw.
🌿 Bush Hat – Gather twigs and spawn bushes to hide your team.
🦑 Ink Hat – Splash ink on the glass and block the claw player’s view.
❄️ Ice Hat – Freeze the claw at the last second to stop a grab in its tracks.

Fast Rounds, Big Chaos

Perfect for parties, family nights, or spontaneous fun with friends. Rounds are short, tension runs high – who plays it smarter? The friends helping and tricking each other, or the claw trying to stay in control? Every match is a fast-paced duel between chaos and control – and no one stays calm for long.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 or AMD R9 290
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • VR Support: SteamVR, OpenXR | Quest 3
  • Additional Notes: VR device compatibility TBD | only tested headsets listed
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1060 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • VR Support: SteamVR, OpenXR | Quest 3
  • Additional Notes: VR device compatibility TBD | only tested headsets listed

short_description: In local multiplayer Grab Your Friends, one player in VR controls the claw of a claw machine, while friends on their phones run, hide, and cause chaos inside using special hats. Short, exciting rounds—perfect for any game night.
